name: Universal TV Table Horizontal Scroll
description: Makes wide tables horizontally scrollable instead of breaking TV layout

params.code: document.querySelectorAll('table').forEach(function(table) { if (table.offsetWidth > window.innerWidth * 0.9) { var wrapper = document.createElement('div'); wrapper.style.cssText = 'overflow-x:auto;max-width:100%;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:8px;margin:16px 0;'; table.parentNode.insertBefore(wrapper, table); wrapper.appendChild(table); } table.style.fontSize = '16px'; table.style.lineHeight = '1.6'; var cells = table.querySelectorAll('th, td'); cells.forEach(function(c) { c.style.padding = '12px 16px'; }); }); return 'tables-fixed';
